Last4pairs transfer task/copy. Matching-template fits. Finite normalized-MLP-input projected donor changes, without renormalization; downstreamlive, restrecipient. Full change is MLP-only donor substitution, not wholeprompt swap. Existingreused panels, no semanticlabel assigned to endpointorder.
